top_buys.pitch: A $600M ammonia plant purchase quietly adds low-cost US capacity.
top_buys.why: CF Industries is buying Mosaic's Louisiana ammonia plant for $600 million, adding output on cheap US natural gas. Deals this size in a mid-cap rarely get fully priced on day one and the strategic logic of consolidating Gulf Coast ammonia is clear. Materials have lagged, which leaves room if nitrogen pricing stays firm.
top_buys.risks: Natural gas cost spikes or weak nitrogen prices would erode the economics, and farm economics remain soft.
top_buys.watch: Nitrogen price benchmarks and any detail on the deal's expected earnings contribution.

top_buys.pitch: Revenue miss after the diabetes spinoff leaves estimates drifting lower.
top_buys.why: Medtronic missed quarterly revenue expectations, with the diabetes spinoff muddying the growth picture. Large medtech names that miss tend to see analysts trim numbers over the following days rather than all at once. Health Care has been roughly flat, so this is a company-specific call rather than a sector bet.
top_buys.risks: Medtronic is a defensive, low-beta name that can be bought as a safe haven if the broader market keeps falling.
top_buys.watch: Analyst estimate revisions over the next week and management's guidance commentary.
